# uptimeify_im_channel (Resource)

An Incident Management paging channel (Slack incoming webhook, generic webhook or email). Escalation tiers and the organization fallback page through it. Incident Management must be active for the organization. The webhook URL and header values are secrets: the API never returns them, so they are write-only here. Import with the numeric id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "slack_webhook_url" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Organization-wide Slack channel, also usable as the escalation fallback.
resource "uptimeify_im_channel" "ops_slack" {
  name               = "Ops Slack"
  type               = "slack"
  webhook_url_wo     = var.slack_webhook_url
  secrets_wo_version = 1 # bump to resend the URL after rotating it
}

# Team-scoped email channel.
resource "uptimeify_im_channel" "dba_mail" {
  name    = "DBA mailbox"
  type    = "email"
  team_id = 9
  email   = "dba-oncall@example.com"
}

resource "uptimeify_im_org_settings" "this" {
  fallback_channel_id = tonumber(uptimeify_im_channel.ops_slack.id)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) 1 to 120 characters, no surrounding whitespace.
- `type` (String) `webhook`, `slack` or `email`.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `email` (String) `type = "email"`: recipient address (required there).
- `headers_wo` (Map of String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) `webhook`/`slack`: extra request headers (no `Host`). Write-only: sent on create and whenever `secrets_wo_version` changes, then replacing the stored set (unset = remove all). The names are readable as `header_names`.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Default `true`. The organization fallback channel cannot be deactivated.
- `secrets_wo_version` (Number) Change to resend `webhook_url_wo` and `headers_wo`.
- `team_id` (Number) Team of the organization; unset = organization-wide channel.
- `webhook_url_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) `webhook`/`slack`: public http(s) URL, required on create. Write-only: sent on create, on a `type` change and whenever `secrets_wo_version` changes.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `has_webhook_url` (Boolean) Whether a webhook URL is stored.
- `header_names` (List of String) Names of the stored headers, sorted (values are never returned).
- `id` (String) Numeric channel id.
- `organization_id` (Number)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uptimeify_im_channel.ops_slack 12
```
